card.name: Inside rare split-up names
card.fires_on: The middle or end piece of a rare name or word split into parts, such as INCRA, porpoise, intrathecally, incantation and Norpace.

modes.label: Drug names and warnings
modes.description: Later piece of a drug name or an all-caps route word in dosing text.

modes.label: Rare general words and acronyms
modes.description: Inner piece of an uncommon word or acronym in general prose.
modes.example: 15 percent of all deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon had occurred in INC<<RA>> areas.

card.writes: It mostly pushes down words like incorporate and into, which fits word pieces starting with inc or in; the promoted tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It fires inside unusual words and names that are broken into pieces, such as Norpace or INCRA.
